resultList.dtldesc: Discover a modern living experience with this 3 BHK flat in the sought-after Tata Amantra, Kalyan, beyond Thane. Designed for comfort and convenience, this home offers spacious interiors and contemporary finishes, set within a well-connected, thriving community. Amantra, ideally situated along the Bhiwandi Kalyan Corridor, stands as a symbol of elevated living and style. This development seamlessly blends urban serenity with modern elegance. Comprising mid and high-rise towers, the tallest rising to 34 storeys, it offers spacious and thoughtfully designed 2  3 bedroom apartments. The property features lush landscaping, premium amenities, and ample podium parking across three levels, making it the perfect home. Some residences boast stunning views of the Ulhas River, sunrise, pastures, and the skylines of Thane, Kalyan, and Bhiwandi.Property SpecificationsDesigned to meet the modern needs of the residents, this flat offers a spacious 876 sqft of living space on the 4th floor of a well-maintained 29-story building. The living and dining areas provide an open, airy space, perfect for family gatherings. Both bathrooms are equipped with western-style fittings, with one being attached to the master bedroom and the other serving as a common bathroom.Enjoy the outdoors with two balconiesone connected to the bedroom and the other to the kitchen, both offering views of the highway. The flat also comes with durable ceramic tile flooring throughout, ensuring long-lasting appeal.FacilitiesThe property offers covered parking, 24-hour water supply, and 100 power backup for lights, fans, and the lift. Safety is a priority with a security guard, CCTV surveillance, and a single lift serving the building. Residents can also enjoy a range of top-tier amenities, including a clubhouse, indoor games room, green spaces, gym, badminton court, kids play area, 15th-floor jogging track, kids room, infinity pool, sauna, steam room, theater, card room, and play court.LocalityThe property is strategically located near key landmarks such as the Mumbai-Nasik Expressway and the New BKC Bhiwandi Kalyan Corridor. Aventura International School, Euro-kids Pre School, and Life Line Hospital are all within easy reach. Viviana Mall and Korum Mall are just a 30-minute drive away. Public transport options, including buses and autos, are easily accessible, and Kalyan Railway Station is nearby. Additionally, banks and ATMs are conveniently located within the same complex. Also, the upcoming metro station is likely to enhance connectivity.
